changes_made: KeyboardMappingService.checkKeyboardMappings(): added VALID_HOST_KEY allowlist regex for the sendKeys dispatch path. Before calling navigationService.sendKeys(keyFunc), keyFunc is validated against a regex allowing only valid ApplinX host key names (pf1-pf36, pa1-pa3, enter, clear, erase, attn, sysreq, reset, backtab, tab, home, end, insert, delete, pageup, pagedown, up, down, left, right). Unknown key strings are rejected and logged as errors instead of being dispatched.

files_modified.changes: checkKeyboardMappings() sendKeys branch (no-parentheses path): added VALID_HOST_KEY regex constant, wrapped navigationService.sendKeys(keyFunc) in if(VALID_HOST_KEY.test(keyFunc)) guard. Invalid key strings log error instead of dispatching.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: ApplinX host key allowlist: only standard ApplinX function key names are dispatched via sendKeys(). Arbitrary strings from server-controlled or tampered KeyboardMappings.json are rejected before reaching the ApplinX REST API sendKeys endpoint.
secondary_controls: VULN-002 fix (same file): prototype chain hijack in the parentheses-dispatch path is the higher-severity companion vulnerability — also fixed
VULN-018 fix: artifact signing makes KeyboardMappings.json tampering detectable
detection: Blocked key strings logged as error using existing messages service pattern

validation_criteria: keyFunc='[pf3][pf3][pf3]' → rejected (multiple keys in one value, not matching single key pattern)
keyFunc='DROP TABLE users' → rejected, error logged
